components.title: Synchronized factory replacement authority
components.summary: Authenticates the network player/AI context, decodes the bounded wire request and routes it to the synchronized service, which owns incarnation, fence, replay and result-ring state.

components.title: Queue cancellation, refund and callback lifetime
components.summary: Revalidates the actor lifetime and queue around strict policy callbacks, swaps the queue and commits cancellation/result state before destruction and command notifications, while AI authority activation/retirement and save-load preserve incarnation state.

flows.title: Network action to synchronized atomic replacement

steps.description: Validate packet/player, resolve the authenticated AI context, decode the submission and compare the requested incarnation on the synchronized network action path.
Re-decode the request, enforce authority incarnation, replay sequence, frame, fence, actor ownership/lifetime and qualified count before invoking the factory transaction.
Acquire the callback scope, capture queue/cancellation state, run strict policy callbacks and revalidate all captured state before commit.
Swap the production queue, commit build cancellation and durable result state, then clear waits and emit cancellation/icon/UnitCommand notifications.
Activate a fresh authority or require a restored nonzero incarnation before registering the AI slot.
Retire the exact player/AI/team authority slot before clearing handler state.
Rebuild AI registry state without retiring/reactivating preserved replacement authorities after deserialization.
Serialize factory replacement service state with the engine save-load stream.

facts.statement: Factory cancellation marks the unfinished buildee dead before UnitDestroyed notifications; the factory transaction commits queue, cancellation and result state before later notification callouts.

The synchronized source records a result around the atomic transaction, but the indexed source does not by itself establish real-game refund amounts, observer timing, two-peer replay identity or completed Count1/2/4 products.

open_questions: Do controlled native intervals prove no observer-visible partial queue/cancellation state and exact metal-only refund including overflow?
Do two authenticated peers read the same immutable sequence/request/digest result after replay and save-load?
The nested AI gitlinks are excluded from this engine corpus and require their own exact registrations when used.
